about: The engine enums mods see, read from Source/D2Headers/d2_enums.h by tools/src/enums.ts into api/enums.d.ts. Values are the header's. Member names: the common prefix up to an underscore is stripped and the rest is PascalCase (an all-caps word is capitalised, a mixed-case word keeps its case); 'rename' gives a member its name outright, 'exclude' leaves out sentinels and unknowns. Two members with one name fail the build.
